notes.title: Major Update 1.7
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

As the head of the [b]One Eleven[/b] project, I want to apologize for the long delay in releasing new content. We have put a lot of effort into shaping the game into what we envisioned, and we truly hope that our work has paid off.

Here’s what awaits you in this patch:

[b]10 new achievements [/b]– for the most dedicated explorers,
[b]15 new timelines[/b] – even more alternative paths,
[b]25 new endings[/b] – your choices matter more than ever,
[b]50 pages of new text [/b]– deeper story details and character development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/d61e95088f4d098292de58624d6fd717f7016d6d.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we’ve addressed some long-standing issues:
[list]
[*] Gallery improvements,
[*] Fixes for logical errors,
[*] Corrections for typos and text inconsistencies,
[*] Game optimization for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support! We’re committed to making [b]One Eleven[/b] even better.

notes.title: 1.6b New Patch
notes.content:
Hello,

I hope you are doing well!
We hasten to please you, we have corrected the well-known typos in the English language. As you understand, we did not do them intentionally. It’s just that our voice actress tried very hard and conveyed emotions a little differently from the text. But now everything has been fixed, so feel free to play and enjoy the game.

As for episode 2, expect it at the end of the year. All text is written and translated. All we have to do is wait for the voice acting and we are ready!

notes.title: Major Update 1.6
notes.content:
Greetings,
I am glad to inform you that today we are launching a[b] 70% discount on steam[/b]. This is a great opportunity to purchase the game as a gift for friends, or for yourself if you haven’t done so yet. ([i]why?[/i] [b];([/b] )
In addition to the discount, the game is getting a [b]Major Update #1.6[/b] that affects both the main game and the DLC. It also sets the settings for Chapter 2, which we expect to release [b]mid-year 2024[/b].

[b]News:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have started work on Chapter 2
[*] We started work on our second project - Chrono Bullet
[/list]
[b]What did they change?[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Art-pictures for 18+ DLC
[*] Added new Art-pictures with characters in main game
[*] Improved the visual content of the scenes
[*] Fixed errors with saves
[*] Fixed bugs with screen dimming in sex scenes
[*] Fixed bugs with explosion SFX
[*] Fixed a bug in the “Triptych” (now you can always beat the game on Normal difficulty)
[*] Fixed bugs with voice acting
[*] Fixed text typos
[/list]

For any questions you can join us in [b]discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/ZG6EdSASBG ]https://discord.gg/ZG6EdSASBG [/url]
Best regards [b]Vivi[/b].

notes.title: Happy Holidays! 1.5a Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The year is ending and [b]the holidays are approaching[/b], so we wanted to thank [b]everyone for supporting[/b] our work.
The [b]One Eleven[/b] would not have been the same without you and we are truly grateful for your support, comments and feedback that you share in every possible places. Being able to have a look into your reviews, to know what's working for you and what's not is always immensely motivating.

Me and my studio are very proud of what we have accomplished this year:
[list]
[*] [b]Full release of One Eleven[/b] (1 episode)
[*] We started working on a new project - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2663120/Chrono_Bullet/]Chrono Bullet[/url] (we believe that we can finish it next year).
[/list]

Our plans for the next year 2024:
 [list]
[*]Release [b]Chrono Bullet[/b]
[*]Release of new [b]Episodes of One Eleven[/b]
[/list]

Once again,[b] thank you all [/b]so much and hope you'll have a great holiday season, you can join us on [url=https://discord.gg/qQ7muuRYV3]Discord[/url] to chat with the team and other players!
Best regards and [b]Happy New Year![/b]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Hello,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/8ccaf38d37f1529c694c6e394787c1cc1894d5f1.png[/img]
Hot Fix:
- Fixed Timeline_Emilia bug;
- Fixed Endgame Crash;
- Typos corrections.

Funny story:
[i]There was a bug in the game where you while playing DLC 18+, could “stay at home”, but you would get into an intimate scene with Emilia. [b]We fixed it.[/b]

If you ask how did this even happen? 
It's simple, it was a loophole for lazy programmers I have, who used this way to test different scenes in the game. And at the release, they forgot to remove it...
We are ashamed, but I hope you laughed and weren’t upset about it)[/i]

PS.
You still can buy this game by discount! And thank you very much for your help in finding bugs. If you find any issues, please let us know.

Sincerely, ViviLatvia.

notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655055/5d2e409d75a106f3db7124a2a872b5b38659cbfa.png[/img]
Hello,

Indeed, the title is accurate – we're thrilled to present the official release announcement for One Eleven!

We appreciate your patience, though we regret to inform you that due to some technical challenges, your saved progress from the previous version won't be compatible with the current version, requiring you to start anew. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Corrections:
- All characters have a new ending
- Corrected the Gallery and added new ART
- OST downloads now work with Steam, the bugs are fixed
- Updated visuals of romantic scenes
- Fixed a bug with Twitch integration
- Fixed a bug with Full-screen
- More minor bugs fixed.

Additions:
- [b]Added full English voice acting[/b]
- Added cool animations
- Added the “Escape from the Garage” scene
- Added Karma display to easy game mode
- Added chapter selection at the beginning of the game
- Added a new NPC - a dog lady
- Added new dialogues
- Added new animation effects of fire, rain, water
- Added 16 save slots
- Added a mini-game
- Added explosion animation
- Added eye color for characters.

Thank you very much for your help in finding bugs. If you find any issues, please let us know.

Sincerely, ViviLatvia.
